overlayEntry.notes: Measured on BNB Chain at pinned block 112517992 (2026-07-27T22:57:31Z, hash 0xc68417d2a0ff3b2bb6fe650832259fd0e1f3cc1f8fdc6a062f14a3fae31e429d) via bsc-rpc.publicnode.com; journaled in the wave-8 packet draft journal 2026-07-27-asusdf-wrapper-block-112517992.json. The asUSDFEarn wrapper contract (0xdb57a53c..., itemized in Aster's official contract inventory) held 3,480,167.37079955 USDF against asUSDF totalSupply() of 3,268,199.9317093217, an implied wrapper NAV of 1.064858 USDF per asUSDF (>= 1, consistent with the documented NAV-accreting design); ERC-4626 convertToAssets(1e18) and totalAssets() reverted, so the wrapper is not ERC-4626 and the NAV is derived from the pinned balance/supply reads. Upstream USDF totalSupply at the same block was 111,986,088.07905471. The wrapper itself runs no hedge, posts no margin, and maintains no loss-absorption pool: those layers exist only at the upstream USDF mechanism, whose issuer publishes no reconciled hedge notionals, margin figures, or insurance/reserve fund (see the usdf-astherus review), so all three sdn metrics are honestly recorded as unavailable rather than not-applicable, keeping the nondisclosure signal attributed to the Aster evidence gap. venueAndCustody is graded limited under D3 at the wrapper layer: Aster's official contract inventory itemizes the wrapper contract, the issuer-pinned exact-match source shows shares mint only against deposited USDF, and the pinned on-chain reads verify the wrapper holds the full USDF backing of outstanding shares at NAV >= 1; the grade does not go higher because no independent attestation exists and the wrapper's UUPS admin (six-hour timelock behind a 4-of-8 Safe) can change custody logic. All other components are omitted (bounded-unknown) for lack of itemized evidence.

hedgeCoverageRatio.rationale: asUSDF is a pure staking wrapper over USDF; the delta-neutral hedge exists only at the upstream USDF layer, whose issuer publishes no reconciled hedge notionals or net delta (searched the Aster USDF/asUSDF documentation set and product surface; no transparency or attestation API exists).

marginBufferPct.rationale: The wrapper posts no margin of its own; margin for the upstream Binance delta-neutral positions is an Aster/Ceffu-layer quantity for which no balances or maintenance requirements are published anywhere in the Aster documentation set.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: No insurance fund, reserve fund, or quantified loss-absorption pool exists at the wrapper layer or is disclosed for the upstream USDF mechanism in any Aster documentation.

impliedWrapperNav.interpretation: USDF per asUSDF share; >= 1 is consistent with the documented NAV-accreting staking design and confirms full on-chain backing of outstanding wrapper shares at the pinned block. Not used as an sdn metric.

hedgeCoverageRatio.rationale: The wrapper runs no hedge; the upstream USDF hedge exists at the Aster/Ceffu/Binance layer with no published reconciled notionals or net delta.

marginBufferPct.rationale: The wrapper posts no margin; upstream margin balances and maintenance requirements are unpublished.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: No loss-absorption pool exists at the wrapper layer or is disclosed for upstream USDF.

Upstream USDF supply 111,986,088.07905471 at the same block. All three sdn metrics recorded unavailable: the wrapper runs no hedge/margin/loss-absorption layer of its own and the upstream USDF mechanism discloses none of these values. venueAndCustody graded limited (official contract inventory + issuer-pinned exact-match source + pinned on-chain balance verification; no attestation, UUPS admin retains upgrade control). All other components bounded-unknown.
